Turning complex supply chains into smart, digital flows.
We're searching for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Expert with a strong focus on Production Planning (PP)- someone who brings deep industry understanding, process excellence, and the technical chops to drive digital transformation from concept to go-live.

- Take the lead in designing and implementing processes for our production plants
- Provide hands-on customizing and process consulting in the line-of-business "Manufacturing"
- Ensure seamless integration across modules like purchasing, warehouse management, sales, and maintenance
- Support the implementation and adaptation of Fiori apps and mobile solutions in production and logistics environments
- Act as a key advisor for production teams and business stakeholders throughout the ERP transformation journey
- Align production and logistics flows with IT architecture and corporate standards
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enable lean, agile production environments

- Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science or a comparable qualification
- Proven experience as SAP S/4HANA consultant or in-house expert in PP and other logistics modules
- Deep understanding of SAP customizing, process integration and interface topics
- Confident in working with Fiori, mobile use cases, and modern UX strategies
- Strong know-how in production planning, supply chain flows, and manufacturing processes - ideally within capital goods, construction materials, or wood/metal industries

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search / AI Forge (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
Über diesen Job:
CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.
Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.
Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.

Was Du mitbringst:

- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects
- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects
- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit
- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications
- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows
- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance
- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services
- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus
- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not required

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification
- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models
- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases
- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests
- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases
- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement
- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

Was wir Dir bieten:
Development and responsibility

- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly
- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems
- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional development
Team spirit and modern workspace
- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and celebrate our successes at regular company and team events
- Work in an inspiring environment with a modern office and high-quality equipment such as MacBooks and height-adjustable desks
Flexibility and balance
- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days
- Get to the office conveniently with your free Deutschlandticket or a subsidized company bicycle
- Enjoy a free fresh lunch twice a week and use the opportunity to connect with your colleagues
- Stay active with our internal sports classes or take advantage of our subsidized external sports offering, including EGYM Wellpass

jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Taxation (GTAX) is the tax department of Allianz SE, the listed parent company of Allianz Group. GTAX supports the Board of Management in ensuring high-quality, efficient tax reporting and tax compliance, and represents the company before external authorities. With a diverse team of more than 30 tax advisors, lawyers, and senior experts, we enable sustainable growth by providing tax advice to senior management, performing group-wide tax planning, and engaging in strategic projects. GTAX sets group-wide tax standards, steers and coordinates local tax functions to ensure effective tax risk management, and safeguards Allianz's reputation as a responsible taxpayer. We constantly strive for benchmark performance and best practice. Group Tax operates globally, with regular interaction across operating entities, tax authorities, senior management, and C-level stakeholders.

How can you make an impact?

In this role you will take ownership of and drive the following areas:

- GloBE / Pillar 2 Compliance: Own and drive the end-to-end GloBE / Pillar 2 reporting and compliance process for Allianz Group, including fiscal audit topics
- Pillar 2 Tax Planning: Support Pillar 2 tax planning initiatives, proactively identifying risks and opportunities, and steering impact assessments to shape strategic decision-making on investment structures and Group-wide tax positioning
- Governance & Policy Development: Drive the development of governance frameworks, policies, and standards for sustainable Pillar 2 compliance across all jurisdictions
- Process Automation & Standardization: Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization of tax reporting processes and tools to increase efficiency and data quality
- Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR): Manage CbCR to fiscal authorities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
- Public Tax Transparency: Drive public tax transparency reporting, positioning Allianz as a leader in responsible tax governance
- IFRS & Solvency II Tax Accounting: Steer internal and external reporting on the tax situation in quarterly and annual IFRS and Solvency II financial statements, including setting and evolving related tax accounting policies and guidelines across Allianz Group
- Complex Tax Issues & Cross-Functional Projects: Drive the resolution of complex tax accounting issues and act as the central point of accountability for cross-functional projects related to tax accounting and reporting, ensuring alignment with Group strategy

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Academic Background: University degree in business administration, finance, economics, law or a related field; certified tax advisor (Steuerberater) preferred
- Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience as tax advisor, tax manager, or in-house tax specialist
- IFRS & Solvency II Expertise: Proven experience in IFRS tax accounting and reporting, including expert IAS 12 knowledge
- Global Minimum Tax Knowledge: Deep expertise in Global Minimum Tax / Pillar 2 / GloBE regulations and hands-on experience in implementation projects, including related IT tool landscapes
- International Tax Expertise: Expert knowledge in national and international taxation, ideally with a focus on investment structures
- Technical & Digital Skills: Very good knowledge of Excel, SAP, and AI-powered tools; experience in IT tool development/implementation and data analysis
- Language Skills: Business-fluent English (German is a plus)
- Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to analyze complex tax data and translate findings into actionable insights

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management: Proven ability to manage and drive complex projects independently from initiation to completion
- AI & Automation: Experience with AI solutions, Generative AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Copilot), and automation of tax processes
- Communication & Teamwork: Excellent communication and presentation skills; collaborative team player with stakeholder management experience
- Attention to Detail: Structured, detail-oriented, and consistent way of working with the ability to address complex issues
- Industry Experience: Previous experience in insurance, asset management, financial services, or consulting
- Digital Affinity: Interest in or experience with digital transformation, data analytics, and tech-driven process optimization
- Problem-Solving: Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop pragmatic solutions in a dynamic, international environment
- Ethical AI Awareness: Understanding of Responsible AI principles and their application in a corporate tax environment

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Manager, Indirect Procurement – Engineering Services, Supplies & Equipment (EMEA) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.

What You’ll Do

- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.
- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).
- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.
- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.
- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.
- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.
- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.
- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.
- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.
- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.
- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.

What You’ll Bring

- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.
- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience
- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred
- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).
- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.
- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.
- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).
- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.
- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Allianz's strong inclusive culture encourages people to speak their minds, get involved and question the status quo. One means to cultivate teams with different perspectives is a regular rotation of Allianz Executive employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, the company expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group.
Who will you join?

The Group Tax - International Tax Planning & Investments team plays a pivotal role in shaping Allianz's global tax strategy. We are responsible for:

- Ensuring robust tax governance across all international operations (insurance and asset management), including defining, implementing, and continuously enhancing global tax standards and frameworks across the Allianz Group
- Leading tax structuring and lifecycle oversight of investments - from acquisition through holding to exit - including compliance, reporting, and audit support
- Driving tax planning and value optimization initiatives, aligned with Group financial objectives and capital efficiency

How can you make an impact?

A. Leadership of Transactions and Investment Structure:

- Drive the tax structuring, coordination, and execution of acquisitions, divestments, restructurings in complex international environment, ensuring tax considerations are embedded at the core of strategic decision process and aligned with tax strategy and governance standards
- Take end-to-end ownership of tax workstreams in transactions, orchestrating collaboration with local tax functions, asset managers, and external advisors
- Shape and approve the design of new investment structures and platforms for alternative investments
- Act as a key contributor to Group approval processes, providing clear, decision-oriented tax recommendations to senior stakeholders and committees

B. (Investment) Tax Planning:

- Design, drive, and implement tax planning and restructuring initiatives to optimize effective tax rate (ETR)/cash. This includes current and deferred taxes as well as impact on global minimum taxation
- Proactively identify and execute value creation opportunities, including safeguarding and optimizing tax attributes and capital-efficient structuring
- Anticipate and respond to global tax developments, ensuring timely adaptation of investment strategies and structures to maintain competitiveness and compliance

C. Risk Management:

- Identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax risks in relation to complex international, cross-border matters and investment activities
Support tax audits, controversy management, ensuring consistent and robust representation of Group positions

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Degree in business administration, economics, taxation, or law
- Certified tax advisor
- 5+ years professional experience as tax advisor or inhouse tax manager
- Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)
- Knowledge in SAP R3 / S4 Hana and MS Office

Preferred Qualifications

- Expert knowledge in national and international taxes (as well as Global Minimum Taxation), ideally with specific focus on investment structures
- Strong analytical and project management skills
- Experience with AI solutions and automatization of tax processes
- Highly motivated team player taking ownership, driving initiatives end-to-end, and consistently delivering results with a strong sense of accountability
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solutions

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified
